name: @story/visualizer-client
comment:dependencies: Grepped from the moved tree, not guessed. `@emotion/react` is the one entry with no direct import: it is the required peer of `@emotion/styled` (11 direct imports) and of `@mui/material`, so it is declared here rather than relied on through hoisting. The root's `d3`, `jlouvain`, `ngraph.forcelayout`, `ngraph.graph` and `@types/d3` had zero imports anywhere in the repo and were deleted instead of moved (REFACTOR_PLAN §7). `@story/core` and `@story/data` are devDependencies since Visualizer WP1: the client imports them type-only (the server is its only source of story data, plan §3 "Live refresh"), and `eslint.config.js` rejects a runtime import. `@story/visualizer-protocol` is the typed contract with `Visualizer/server`.
